title: Purity in the Camp and the Law of Restitution
description: The Lord commands Moses that anyone who is unclean because of a skin disease, a discharge, or contact with the dead must be sent outside the camp so that the camp will not become defiled where the Lord dwells. Furthermore, the Lord gives rules for how someone who has acted treacherously must confess their sin and make full restitution, adding one-fifth to what was taken from the person wronged. If there is no close relative to receive restitution, it goes to the priest along with the ram of atonement.
